# `<e-icon>`

<p><img alt="e-icon screenshot" src="../__tests__/__screenshots__/primitives-icon--allicons.png" width="480" /></p>

Inline SVG icon resolved by name from the built-in icon set.

> Source: [icon.ts](./icon.ts)

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | — | Icon identifier (must exist in the `ICONS` registry). |
| `size` | `number` | `20` | Pixel size (width and height). |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible label. Without a label the icon is treated as decorative. |
